phases.title: 4 Phases of Female Hormonal Cycle
phases.subtitle: Understand how estrogen and progesterone fluctuations impact fertility, vitality, and mood.
phases.phase1Desc: Shedding of the uterine lining. Hormones are at baseline. Focus on hydration and iron-rich nutrition.
phases.phase2Desc: FSH hormone matures ovarian follicles. Estrogen rises quickly, boosting energy and cervical fluid.
phases.phase3Desc: LH surge triggers the release of a mature egg. Peak fertile window with egg-white cervical mucus.
phases.phase4Desc: Progesterone dominance and BBT rise prepare the uterus for pregnancy or the next cycle.

infoModal.title: Clinical Methodology & Privacy
infoModal.section1Desc: Algorithms use a combination of Ogino-Knaus and Wilcox et al. fertility research consensus (The New England Journal of Medicine):
infoModal.spermLifespan: Sperm viability: Up to 5 days in fertile cervical mucus.
infoModal.eggLifespan: Egg viability: Only 12 to 24 hours after release from the follicle.
infoModal.fertileWindow: Fertile window: 5 days leading up to ovulation plus the ovulation day itself (total 6 biological days).
infoModal.section2Desc: Most standard calculators rigidly fix the luteal phase at 14 days. Luna provides customization options (10–18 days) for users who know their luteal duration from basal body temperature tracking.
infoModal.section3Desc: If your cycle varies between shortest and longest, the earliest fertile day is calculated from (shortest cycle - 18 days) and latest fertile day from (longest cycle - 11 days).
infoModal.privacyDesc: Your menstrual cycle calculations and personal data are processed locally in your browser.
